maximum_permitted_stay: Social Visit Pass: up to 30 days per entry; SEV validity conflicts: Dhaka FAQ says 3 months, current MYVISA terms say 6 months.
entry_count: Single-entry SEV; MEV only if approved.
passport_validity_rule: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months from the intended travel date.
blank_passport_pages_rule: The MYVISA eVISA terms do not state a universal blank-page count. The separate Dhaka paper/agency checklist dated 7 July 2026 asks for at least 3 continuous empty pages; follow the route-specific instruction.
return_ticket_rule: The Dhaka social-visit FAQ lists a return flight ticket; MYVISA terms require a confirmed return ticket if applicable.
proof_of_funds_rule: Financial-support evidence may be requested. The Dhaka FAQ asks for a bank statement and solvency letter; the Dhaka pages differ on 3 versus 6 months. Follow the live MYVISA upload prompt and confirm with the High Commission if asked.
accommodation_rule: Proof of paid accommodation is required. If staying with a friend or relative, provide the Malaysian address and host details as directed by the MYVISA FAQ.
travel_insurance_rule: No general mandatory travel-insurance rule is stated in the reviewed MYVISA social-visit terms; suitable cover is recommended.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No additional Bangladesh-specific tourist health rule was identified in the reviewed visa guidance; follow current Malaysian public-health and border-entry notices.
transit_rule: Transit depends on the itinerary and whether the traveller clears immigration. No blanket Bangladesh airside-transit exemption was confirmed; check the exact route with the airline and Malaysian Immigration.
application_channel: Bangladesh is listed among nationalities for whom eVISA is compulsory for social visits. Apply through the official MYVISA portal from outside Malaysia and obtain the eVISA before travel; apply at least 14 days before departure. The Dhaka High Commission also lists authorised agencies for assisted applications; agency fees are separate.
application_fee: RM20 government visa fee + RM105 eVISA processing charge; 0.8% card / 1.7% e-wallet; agency fee extra.
processing_time: 2–7 working days after complete payment/submission; holidays excluded. Apply at least 14 days before travel.

review_notes: Bangladesh ordinary-passport social-visit eVISA is compulsory under the current MYVISA nationality list. The central MYVISA terms updated 6 October 2026 state SEV validity of 6 months from issue, 2–7 working-day processing, application at least 14 days before travel, 6-month passport validity and 30-day MEV stays. The Dhaka FAQ separately describes the social visit pass as not exceeding 30 days and lists a return ticket, hotel reservation and bank statement/solvency. The Dhaka paper/agency page lists two printed photos, 3 blank pages, a 3-month bank statement and BDT3,100; those paper/agency instructions and fee must not be conflated with the direct eVISA route (RM20 government fee plus RM105 processing charge). The Dhaka FAQ says 6 months of bank statements while the July 2026 paper/agency page says 3 months; the live MYVISA upload prompt and any mission request control. The official eVISA FAQ specifies a 35 × 50 mm digital studio photo, white background and age under 6 months, but does not publish pixel dimensions or file-size limits. The 35 × 45 mm size in an uploaded agency-preparation checklist is not an official Malaysian requirement. Material validity conflict: the central MYVISA terms updated 6 October 2026 state a single-entry visa is valid for 6 months from issue, while the High Commission of Malaysia in Dhaka FAQ states 3 months. The sources do not clearly reconcile whether this difference is route-specific for Bangladeshi social-visit applicants. The Dhaka FAQ also asks for 6 months of bank statements while the July 2026 paper/agency checklist says 3 months. Keep verification_status pending_review and publication disabled until the High Commission confirms the controlling eVISA validity and financial-document period in writing.
notes: Full route-specific Bangladesh ordinary-passport tourism refresh. Photo specification remains partially specified because pixel/file-size limits are not published in the reviewed official eVISA guidance; applicant checklists distinguish the direct eVISA route from the paper/agency route. Publication is blocked pending written High Commission clarification of the 3-month versus 6-month SEV validity and the 3-month versus 6-month bank-statement period.
